collection.title: Skoda Roomster 2006 to 2013 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Skoda Roomster 2006 to 2013 model requires a 21" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side, all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Push Button arm attachment. We also have rear blade for this Roomster, simply click on the Rear Blades tab below.
